Title: Public Preview: Run Azure Load Testing on Azure Functions

Body.Content: You can now create and run load tests directly from Azure Functions in Azure portal. Load test your functions by simply selecting the function, key and specifying request parameters and load configuration. You will automatically gain access to client-side and Functions metrics, which will help in identifying performance bottlenecks. You can also view the test run history to continuously monitor your Function App performance. Learn more.
